description: The Water Information Systems Portal of Mexico's National Water Commission gathers in one place the institutional systems that publish information on the country's water resources. The portal and its programme page read on 2026-09-28 link the National Water Information System (SINA), with maps, tables and graphs downloadable in several formats; the Public Register of Water Rights (REPDA) of concessions, assignments and discharge permits; monthly precipitation and the National Meteorological Service; the hydrological information system (SIH); groundwater and water quality; the national wetlands inventory; dam monitoring and the dam safety system; the aquifer and basin GIS (SIGACUA); the national system of drinking water, sewerage and sanitation tariffs; the national flood risk atlas (ANRI); the surface water database BANDAS; and publications such as the water statistics and atlas and irrigation district statistics. Coverage is Mexico. Access is free on the web; licences are set per system and were not read. Caveats: it is a gateway, and each system has its own formats and update cycles. It supports flood, drought and supply planning studies, such as linking dam storage, water rights and flood risk by basin. Related records: the CONAGUA open data on hydrological stations and the irrigation district statistics.
